title: Developer check: a failed save puts the field back and shows an error
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Turn off this computer's network connection (Wi-Fi off or network cable unplugged), so the next save of a Sales Representative change fails.
  2. Pick sales rep A in the Sales Representative field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The browser is offline.
  • The field still reads "Unassigned".

Step 2:

  • The field returns to the last saved value ("Unassigned").
  • An error message shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-N3: “If a change cannot be saved, the field returns to the last saved value and an error message shows.”
